leaderboardFeatures.name: Shot Details
leaderboardFeatures.tooltipText: The Shot Details view allows you to simultaneously see information on each player's last shot

leaderboardFeatures.name: Probability
leaderboardFeatures.tooltipText: The Probability view shows each player's projected percentage to win, finish in the Top-10 and more

leaderboardFeatures.name: Strokes Gained
leaderboardFeatures.tooltipText: Strokes Gained displays the number of Strokes the player was better/worse than the field average.

leaderboardFeatures.name: Hole-by-Hole
leaderboardFeatures.tooltipText: View the hole-by-hole scores for each player on the Leaderboard for the selected round.  Use the round selector to see other round scores
